## Reusable definitions, equations, and identities

The successor reuses the predecessor's 52 requirement and 25 prediction
identities, estimator equations, order statistic, inclusive support predicates,
operator, response/covariance families, unique-original exposure construction,
and equal-observation coadd equations. It incorporates owner-approved changes
under the existing subjects rather than deriving alternatives or appending
editorial IDs.

The uniform family science is referenced rather than reproduced. MAP consumes
the typed coefficient after explicit selection, complete PTC publication,
exact association, producer QC, MAP permission, and requested/applicable/
eligible/realized handoff. MAP retains independent admission and numerical
classification.

## Unresolved or conflicting questions

No scientific contradiction was found among the approved inputs, and no new
scientific decision is required to draft the bounded candidate. The future
canonical commit, successor source-manifest identity, and immutable VAL
Registry/source-binding successor are not scientific inputs; they remain
pending integration identities in the binding proposal. No digest is invented.

## Work performed and excluded material

The only new work is faithful incorporation, source/boundary/profile mapping,
shared-core parity, and rendering. No estimator, coefficient family, parameter,
default, threshold, mode profile, response method, covariance model, OOF
contract, NOI permission, FRUIT method, application statement, test result,
qualification, or production claim was created. Implementation, audits,
repairs, validation evidence, production state, Git history, sibling
repositories, and the manager recovery were excluded from the author channel.
